tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Use this when you need to find or choose an MCP server for a task: it gives the one to install. One MCP server for a task, chosen by fit to the task and then by the score from a real run, never by popularity. The server must start and must have the words of the task; when none does, the answer is no

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
